name: Dividend Tracker
description: A comprehensive dividend income dashboard: monthly income, growth, forward projections, yield-on-cost and diversification, in the Wealthfolio design language.
author: Nissan Itzhakov

permissions.purpose: List accounts so holdings can be grouped and valued
Read holdings and the income summary to compute dividend income, yields, growth and projections
Read dividend activities to compute accurate trailing 12-month income and per-holding yields
Convert non-base-currency dividends to the portfolio base currency at each payment date
Resolve ticker symbols to provider symbols when building the external dividend source
Read asset provider configuration to resolve the exact Yahoo ticker (e.g. EMCL.NE)
Fetch per-share dividend history from query1.finance.yahoo.com to compute indicated yield and forward payments
